QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Looking Into the Lion King: Final
QuestInfo.0: #p2161012#'s research is finally complete! Find out what he knows.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161012# thinks the #b#t4033114##k could be the cause of all of this. Go deep into the Lion King's Castle, defeat the #r#o8210013##k, and bring back the #b#t4033114##k.\n\n#i4033114# #t4033114# #b#c4033114#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought the #t4033114# to #p2161012#. Your contribution may bring some hope to the Lion King's Castle.

0.0: Alright. I brewed up all that goo you brought and I've got some news.\r\n#L0##bIs it true? Did dark energy really take over the Lion King's Castle?#l\n#k
0.1: Yep. This here #t4033113# is a little leave-behind. Luckily, the #t4000630# purified so much of the dark energy that it didn't do as much damage as it did in other places.\r\n#L0##bThat explains why this place was deserted...#l\n#k
0.2: It's that blasted Black Mage trying to poison our world! This is exactly why the Silent Crusade exists.\r\n#L0##bYou're right! What can I do to help?#l\n#k
0.3: For a place to be under darkness for this long. There's got to be something causing it. Some kind of #ressence of evil#k, you know? You think you could help me find it?

yes.0: This is the last thing I'll ask you to do. I'll make sure nothing comes in after you, just get down to the #rdeepest part of the castle#k and take care of whatever's causing this. I'm gonna owe you big time.

no.0: Alright, I guess I'm going it alone on this one.

1.0: It was worth the wait. Is that it?

yes.0: This is... like nothing I've ever felt. You really did a good thing today. The castle won't be coming back overnight, but at least the evil won't spread anymore. You're the pride of the Silent Crusade.

item.0: Any monster holding on to enough evil to cause all this is gonna be nasty. Keep your mind on the mission.
